conditions.description: Participation is limited to legal entities established in EU Member States, Iceland, Norway, and associated countries: Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
Entities controlled by non-eligible countries may be excluded unless guarantees are provided.
Activities are expected to start at TRL 2 and achieve TRL 5 by the end of the project.
Maximum EU contribution per project is EUR 19,000,000.
The instrument type is Research and Innovation Actions (RIA). Standard RIA consortium composition rules apply under Horizon Europe General Annexes.
conditions.assumption_note: The call slice and curated extract do not explicitly state minimum consortium size or partner type requirements beyond the geographic restriction. RIA instrument type is confirmed; standard Horizon Europe RIA consortium rules (minimum 3 legal entities from 3 different Member States or associated countries) are structurally expected but not explicitly stated in the source documents.

conditions.description: Open access to research results is expected as per standard Horizon Europe RIA obligations.
conditions.inference_note: The scope explicitly requires sharing communicable results through the AI-on-demand platform with the European R&D community. This, combined with the RIA instrument type confirmed in the call slice, implies standard Horizon Europe open access obligations apply. The derivation chain is: RIA instrument type (call_type field) + explicit result-sharing mandate (Scope field) → open access obligation.
